chk_users_email_lowercase.name: chk_users_email_lowercase
chk_users_email_lowercase.value: CAST(`email` AS BINARY) = CAST(LOWER(`email`) AS BINARY)

chk_role_assignments_revocation.name: chk_role_assignments_revocation
chk_role_assignments_revocation.value: (`is_active` = 1 AND `revoked_at` IS NULL AND `revoked_by` IS NULL) OR (`is_active` = 0 AND `revoked_at` IS NOT NULL AND `revoked_by` IS NOT NULL)

chk_user_program_exclusions_manual_reaso.name: chk_user_program_exclusions_manual_reason
chk_user_program_exclusions_manual_reaso.value: `origin` <> 'manual' OR (`reason` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`reason`) <> '')

chk_user_program_exclusions_dismissed.name: chk_user_program_exclusions_dismissed
chk_user_program_exclusions_dismissed.value: `status` <> 'dismissed' OR (`origin` = 'reporting' AND `end_reason` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`end_reason`) <> '')

chk_user_program_exclusions_ended.name: chk_user_program_exclusions_ended
chk_user_program_exclusions_ended.value: (`status` = 'active' AND `ended_at` IS NULL AND `ended_by` IS NULL AND `end_reason` IS NULL) OR (`status` <> 'active' AND `ended_at` IS NOT NULL AND (`ended_by` IS NOT NULL OR (`origin` = 'reporting' AND `status` = 'removed')))

idem_key.name: idem_key
idem_key.type: varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin

chk_cycles_lifecycle.name: chk_cycles_lifecycle
chk_cycles_lifecycle.value: (`status` = 'draft' AND `activated_at` IS NULL AND `activated_by` IS NULL AND `closed_at` IS NULL AND `closed_by` IS NULL) OR (`status` = 'active' AND `activated_at` IS NOT NULL AND `activated_by` IS NOT NULL AND `closed_at` IS NULL AND `closed_by` IS NULL) OR (`status` = 'closed' AND `closed_at` IS NOT NULL AND `closed_by` IS NOT NULL)

chk_timelines_updated.name: chk_timelines_updated
chk_timelines_updated.value: (`updated_at` IS NULL AND `updated_by` IS NULL) OR (`updated_at` IS NOT NULL AND `updated_by` IS NOT NULL)

chk_timeline_users_removed.name: chk_timeline_users_removed
chk_timeline_users_removed.value: (`removed_at` IS NULL AND `removed_by` IS NULL) OR (`removed_at` IS NOT NULL AND `removed_by` IS NOT NULL)

chk_field_config_drafts_updated.name: chk_field_config_drafts_updated
chk_field_config_drafts_updated.value: (`updated_at` IS NULL AND `updated_by` IS NULL) OR (`updated_at` IS NOT NULL AND `updated_by` IS NOT NULL)
